import os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
attempt=sys.argv[1]
cmd=["go","test","-race","-count=3","-timeout=30s","-json","-overlay","analysis/overlay-order.json","-run","^TestIdentity","."]
env=os.environ.copy()
if len(sys.argv)>2:
    run_dir=Path(sys.argv[2])
    env.update({key:str(run_dir / part) for key, part in {"GOCACHE":"go-cache","GOTMPDIR":"go-tmp","TMPDIR":"tmp"}.items()})
    for key in ("GOCACHE","GOTMPDIR","TMPDIR"): Path(env[key]).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with open(f"analysis/probe-{attempt}.stdout.jsonl","xb") as out, open(f"analysis/probe-{attempt}.stderr.log","xb") as err:
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err,env=env)
print("argv",repr(cmd))
print("exit",result.returncode)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
